afterImage.name: Race Communications
afterImage.description: Race Communications is a California fiber-to-the-home platform providing internet service at speeds of up to 10 Gbps together with voice and video services. The company serves residential, small-business, enterprise, and wholesale customers across California and reported a footprint of about 200,000 locations in 2024. Oak Hill Capital remains the majority controller through the Hometown ownership chain, while Munich Re holds a 7.1264% minority equity interest through MEAG-managed MR Redwood. AllianceBernstein's separately disclosed private-credit financing is debt and is not recorded as ownership.
